authorization: Owner requested five further new genuine people, expressly excluding bot-like accounts, then asked to instruct AI Site Check on execution, writing style and five more.
selectionRule: Inspect authored technical work, substantive conversations and corroborating project/release/source evidence. Exclude declared bots/agents, repetitive paraphrase replies, generic AI-summary feeds and mass promotion. Weak ownership evidence means choose another person. This is a practical outreach filter, not proof of human identity or a public accusation.
newMeaning: Five recipients absent from prior original and hourly outreach receipts. Mitchell and Dax were already followed; this does not claim five previously unknown people or five new relationships.

the public C ABI let me keep ghostty-vt-js on an unpatched upstream build, same engine in the browser and headless HTML/ANSI export. useful for agent tooling too, you can inspect terminal state on the backend

items.label: Mitchell Hashimoto / Ghostty
items.selectionEvidence: The original release, current profile and linked author site identify the Ghostty creator. His release article links back to the same X account and gives concrete ABI/packaging details. Strong inspectable project ownership; selection does not rely on follower count. The account was already followed before this batch.
items.contribution: An actual embedding use case: unpatched public C ABI and one engine across browser/headless output. No claim that our pinned WASM has already upgraded to 1.0.

sourceReads.method: Full release article read in browser; identity cross-link and implementation details inspected.

items.label: maddada / Ghostex
items.selectionEvidence: Current profile links the maintained Ghostex repository. Authored release updates, a coordinator demonstration and detailed self-replies explain specific implementation choices. Fresh README inspection corroborates the coordinator feature.
items.contribution: A worker report can carry a path to its raw session artifacts, allowing a coordinator to reopen the evidence. No claim Ghostex lacks this feature or that schema validity proves correctness.

items.copy:
for native page transitions, both documents need @view-transition { navigation: auto }. i emit it at build time in nisli ssg so one route cant silently miss it, same templates for static output and browser components
https://github.com/gkoreli/nisli/tree/main/packages/ssg
items.label: Guillem Garcia / Designobo
items.selectionEvidence: Profile links Designobo; authored launch/demo posts and extended technical exchanges show specific implementation work. Its public product page corroborates the HTML/MCP canvas direction. No performance ranking from the page or thread is adopted.
items.contribution: Nisli SSG emits native cross-document transition opt-in consistently across pages and shares normal templates with browser components. This is a document-navigation detail, not evidence of a replacement for X’s full application.

sourceReads.method: Public product page read; labelled crawled last week, not runtime validation.

items.presentationLimit: X auto-linked the literal CSS @view prefix as an account mention while retaining the typed directive in the canonical title/text. The owner reply menu offered no Edit action; no deletion or extra correction post was made. Avoid literal at-rule spelling in future X prose when a source link suffices.

sourceScope: Fresh public source reads support implementation claims; file hashes are blob hashes, not commits. No new runtime acceptance or benchmark was performed. The failed ghx run is a preliminary historical result, not the current project verdict. Public-site crawl age is preserved where relevant.
publication: Exact copy saved and composer checked before a single submission. Delayed state resolved without resubmission. Each canonical owner URL, body, parent and screenshot retained. New link targets were freshly read as source files or documented package paths.
coordination: AI Site Check was read before handoff. The owner-authorized instruction specifies one further five-reply X batch after this batch finishes, the stricter selection rule, Goga’s connected informal reasoning, relevant project links, verification and deduplication. No new scheduler, Reddit scope, DM or follow was added.
voice: Useful point first, connected informal clauses, lowercase openings and ordinary commas. Do not manufacture mistakes, experiences or certainty. Different contributions: actual embedding use, evidence handoff, evaluation result, document-build behavior and an API acceptance/completion distinction.
countScope: Original chat continuation only. Thirty-four replies in seven separately recorded AI Site Check hourly runs remain a separate historical ledger; the newly requested target-chat batch is not counted as completed.
limits: Signed-in owner publication verified. Independent public visibility, recipient uptake, traffic, causal growth and new relationship formation are unmeasured. One CSS prefix was auto-linked by X; no edit action was available. Raw captures remain private.
